entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into a return for you. To start, could you tell me a bit more about the item? What specifically is the issue?
It's the new cycling shoes I bought. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and saved up for these, but they're just... they're giving me terrible blisters.
Oh, that's definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Blisters can ruin a ride completely. Is it a sizing issue, or something else?
I thought the size was right, but no matter how I position the cleats, my heel just rubs constantly. I can't even go a few miles. I really needed this money back, I was so hoping they'd work out.
I completely understand your frustration, and I'm sorry they didn't work out for you. Let me pull up your account and our policy. I can see your order for the cycling shoes was delivered 24 days ago.
Yes, that sounds right. Is... is that a problem?
Not at all. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely get you a full refund.
Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them. Thank you.

Of course. Our goal is to make sure you have gear that works for you. I've just started the return process and sent a pre-paid shipping label to your email. Just pack the shoes up, and once we receive them, we'll issue the refund to your original payment method.
That's perfect. Thank you so much for your help, Diana.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Have a great rest of your day, and we hope to see you back at VeloFit soon.
